formatMoney takes cents and uses Intl.NumberFormat, so a 2.005 result suggests the rounding is happening before the value reaches it, probably where line totals are computed from fractional quantities. 2.005 is also a classic floating-point case, since it's really stored as 2.00499999... I'll reproduce it before changing anything, and I won't hard-code cents / 100.
Action: add a failing test for the CAD invoice case, trace where the line total is rounded to cents, and fix it there. I'll round each line to whole cents before summing, in a float-safe way.

Your half-finished edits on the /reports page are in the working tree, so I'll keep them out of this commit.
